def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    counts=collections.Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    rare={c for c,n in counts.items() if n <= 0.06*h*w}
    # The sparse colors are the grid-corner marks; their occupied rows/columns define the encoded lattice.
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] in rare]
    rs=sorted({r for r,c in pts}); cs=sorted({c for r,c in pts})
    # Interior fill color is read between consecutive marked lattice lines.
    interior=[]
    for r0,r1 in zip(rs,rs[1:]):
        for c0,c1 in zip(cs,cs[1:]):
            interior.append(grid[(r0+r1)//2][(c0+c1)//2])
    base=collections.Counter(interior).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[]
    for r0,r1 in zip(rs,rs[1:]):
        row=[]
        for c0,c1 in zip(cs,cs[1:]):
            vals=[grid[r0][c0],grid[r0][c1],grid[r1][c0],grid[r1][c1]]
            row.append(vals[0] if vals[0] in rare and all(v==vals[0] for v in vals) else base)
        out.append(row)
    colored=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(out) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=base]
    if not colored: return [[base]]
    rmin=min(r for r,c in colored);rmax=max(r for r,c in colored);cmin=min(c for r,c in colored);cmax=max(c for r,c in colored)
    return [row[cmin:cmax+1] for row in out[rmin:rmax+1]]
for i,blocks in parsed.items():
 inp=blocks[0][3]; expected=blocks[1][3]; got=transform(inp)
 print(i,collections.Counter(v for row in inp for v in row).most_common(),got,got==expected)

source='''import collections


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = collections.Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    rare = {color for color, count in counts.items() if count <= 0.06 * h * w}
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] in rare]
    rows = sorted({r for r, _ in points})
    cols = sorted({c for _, c in points})

    interior = [grid[(r0 + r1) // 2][(c0 + c1) // 2]
                for r0, r1 in zip(rows, rows[1:])
                for c0, c1 in zip(cols, cols[1:])]
    background = collections.Counter(interior).most_common(1)[0][0]

    output = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        line = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            corners = (grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1], grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1])
            color = corners[0]
            line.append(color if color in rare and all(v == color for v in corners) else background)
        output.append(line)

    colored = [(r, c) for r, line in enumerate(output) for c, value in enumerate(line)
               if value != background]
    rmin, rmax = min(r for r, _ in colored), max(r for r, _ in colored)
    cmin, cmax = min(c for _, c in colored), max(c for _, c in colored)
    return [line[cmin:cmax + 1] for line in output[rmin:rmax + 1]]
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); p.write_text(source)
ns={}; exec(compile(source,str(p),'exec'),ns)
for i,blocks in parsed.items():
 assert ns['transform'](blocks[0][3])==blocks[1][3]
